name: Laboratory Operations, Quality, and Safety
description: Quality control theory and practice (Levey-Jennings charts, Westgard multirule interpretation), regulatory frameworks (CLIA, accreditation, proficiency testing), method validation concepts (precision, accuracy, LOD/LOQ, reference intervals), biosafety levels, preanalytic error prevention, order of draw, specimen rejection, point-of-care testing, and laboratory mathematics.
